synthetic_assumptions.amount_aed: lognormal(mu=6.8, sigma=0.55), clipped to [200, 5000], rounded to whole AED
synthetic_assumptions.note: amounts and payout mix are synthetic assumptions, not field data; the PRICING is the real engine

interpretation.ranking_differs_1.0: fee-only and cost-only both always pick the incentive-ineligible promo rail (lowest fee / lowest cost), so on this corridor config they disagree with incentive-aware EV ranking on every transfer — that disagreement IS the product
interpretation.uplift_gap: mean uplift difference between xPay EV ranking and fee-only = the BDT value of computing the 2.5% incentive into the route choice
